title: How do we get there? Evaluating transformer neural networks as cognitive models for English past tense inflection

bias_targets.methodology: Training models with varying type and token frequency distributions to examine if they overgeneralize the most frequent patterns (regular verbs) over irregular patterns.

Evaluating models' zero-shot production of English past tense inflections on nonce verbs to observe their preference (bias) towards applying regular versus irregular inflections compared to human baselines.
